note: Ships with cruise-track files in data/. Vessel pages and the map load tracks only from this list; every other ship shows "No track data yet". To add a ship: export its R2R cruise navigation (one LineString/MultiLineString per cruise, lon/lat, with cruise_id, year, dates, type, chief_scientist, url properties) to data/tracks_<id>.js as window.RV_TRACKS[id], then add it here.
